summary: Rezolve AI plc furnished a Form 6-K/A on October 8, 2026, solely to correct an inadvertent inaccurate statement in Exhibit 99.1 of its original October 7, 2026 Form 6-K; the corrected exhibit replaces the prior Investor Day 2026 transcript in its entirety. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure correcting a transcript error, not a special situation. Watch for any market reaction to the corrected statement and follow-on transcripts, but no deal terms or risk-arb angle exist here.
